description: READ-ONLY. The job's RELEASED effective Instructions pages (the version workers see; Google Doc pages are read live) with their content checksums, the effective instruction-set id and the page-tree checksum — exactly what to pin into a quiz draft's definition.grounding after you read the pages with the Instructions tools (page reads carry the stable block ids, attrs.id, that sourceRefs cite). A job with no released Instructions answers 409 INSTRUCTIONS_NOT_RELEASED. Pass draftPreview: true ONLY when the user asks to ground on unreleased edits: the result carries source: draft_preview and a previewLabel to show the user, and form_publish refuses it with 409 GROUNDING_DRAFT_PREVIEW until the Instructions are released and you re-capture without draftPreview (a preview is never promoted). Copy the returned `grounding` block verbatim; then give each grounded question sourceRefs: [{ pageId, nodeId }] (≤ 20; pageId must be pinned) and an optional rationale (≤ 2000 chars). Workers never see either. Page reads return the employer's DRAFT by default: write every grounded question from the RELEASED text (opentrain_job_instructions_read_page with released: true; its checksum equals the pinned one). Each page of a released snapshot carries draftDiffers: true when the unreleased draft of that page differs or could not be read to compare (always false for Google Doc pages, which are read live); never take question text from the draft of such a page. Never creates an instruction set; resolving the released view may record the same idempotent effective-view row a worker read records. Requires project_todos:read AND instructions:read, a claimed account and the default-off project-todos agent surface.

draftPreview.description: Ground on the UNRELEASED draft as a labeled preview that cannot be published (default false: released Instructions). Only when the user asks for it.

name: opentrain_quiz_grounding_snapshot
